items.name: Polish Sylwester Tour: FMC Warszawa-Wesoła 2025
items.information: Witajcie zawodnicy na zawodach z cyklu Polish Sylwester Tour 2025! Ta edycja odbędzie się w Warszawie, w Dzielnicy Wesoła. Macie okazję ułożyć aż 6 prób FMa w jeden dzień! **Pamiętajcie, że na tych zawodach nie odbywa się standardowe układanie kostki Rubika na czas. Konkurencja Fewest Moves polega na ułożeniu kostki Rubika w jak najmniejszej liczbie ruchów.** Bardzo prosimy o zapoznanie się z [regulaminem](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/), a w szczególności z [artykułem E](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full/#article-E-fewest-moves), który wyjaśnia zasady obowiązujące w konkurencji FMC. Seria Polish Sylwester Tour 2025 to cykl trzech imprez odbywających się tuż przed Sylwestrem 2025 roku: * 28 grudnia: [FMC Warszawa-Wesoła 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PSTFMCWarszawaWesola2025) * 29 grudnia: [Monday Night in Gdańsk 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PSTMondayNightinGdansk2025) * 30 grudnia: [FMC Poznań 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PSTFMCPoznan2025) Serdecznie zapraszamy do wzięcia udziału w tej serii, aby z przytupem zakończyć rok 2025! --- Welcome to the Polish Sylwester Tour 2025! This edition will take place in Warsaw, in the Wesoła District. You have the opportunity to solve as many as six FMC attempts in one day! **Remember, this competition isn't a standard Rubik's Cube speed-solving competition. The Fewest Moves competition involves solving a Rubik's Cube in the fewest moves possible.** We kindly ask you to read the [regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full/), especially [Article E](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full/#article-E-fewest-moves), which explains the rules applicable to the FMC event. The Polish Sylwester Tour 2025 is a series of three competitions taking place just before New Year's Eve 2025: * December 28: [FMC Warszawa-Wesoła 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PSTFMCWarszawaWesola2025) * December 29: [Monday Night in Gdańsk 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PSTMondayNightinGdansk2025) * December 30: [FMC Poznań 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PSTFMCPoznan2025) We cordially invite you to participate in this series to end 2025 with a bang!

items.information: A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz. **ATENÇÃO:** Está é uma competição que não terá o Cubo 3x3x3 como uma de suas modalidades. **ATENÇÃO:** Devido ao tamanho do local da competição, apenas um acompanhante será permitido por competidor. Façamos a competição ser possível para todos os competidores! --- Registration is open to any person, from any country. With a view to the smooth running of the competition, by registering for a category, you also undertake to help as a judge or scrambler in that category (as provided for in the WCA rules). In this way, the competition becomes self-sustaining, and the activities are divided among all participants, not becoming heavy for just a few. At least two groups were made in each modality. In one of the groups you compete and in the other you help to scramble or judge. **ATTENTION:** This competition will not have the 3x3x3 Cube as one of its events. **ATTENTION:** Due to the size of the competition's venue, only one guest will be allowed per competitor. Please do not bring more guests than the allowed quantity, let's make the competition possible for all competitors!
